rules.title: TTC ingestion stale
rules.summary: TTC dashboard data has not been refreshed successfully for 5 minutes.
rules.description: The site is serving stale TTC data. Check ingestion_runs.error_message and backend logs for TtcAlertPollingJob. Single-minute dips during an in-flight poll are normal; this fires only when staleness persists.

rules.title: TTC ingestion processing failing
rules.summary: TTC served its feed normally, but LineWatch failed to process it 3+ times in a row.
rules.description: This is a LineWatch bug or data problem, not a TTC outage. ingestion_runs.error_message names the offending source record.

rules.title: TTC records quarantined
rules.summary: TTC ingestion is setting aside provider records it cannot process; the rest of the feed is live.
rules.description: Riders are missing those alerts or notices. /api/health/ingestion lists them (quarantinedRecords); ingestion_runs.quarantined_records has each cause. Fix the normalizer or schema; TtcProviderRecordContractIntegrationTest should reproduce it.

rules.title: GO/UP ingestion stale
rules.summary: GO/UP alerts have had no fresh successful Metrolinx ingestion run for 15 minutes.
rules.description: Check /api/health/regional-ingestion (collections, status) and the backend log for Metrolinx fetch or processing errors. Metrolinx 401s and 503s are intermittent; this rule waits 15 minutes for that reason.

rules.title: GO/UP records quarantined
rules.summary: Metrolinx ingestion is setting aside records it cannot persist; the rest of the feed is live.
rules.description: /api/health/regional-ingestion lists them (quarantinedRecords); ingestion_runs.quarantined_records has each cause.

rules.title: Backend metrics missing
rules.summary: Grafana is not receiving production backend metrics.
rules.description: The backend is down or unreachable on port 9090, or the Alloy collector stopped shipping metrics. Other LineWatch alerts cannot fire while this is firing.

rules.title: GTFS schedule inactive
rules.summary: No active, unexpired TTC GTFS schedule is loaded.
rules.description: Scheduled arrivals are unavailable. Check the GTFS refresh job or import a schedule with scripts/import-ttc-gtfs-schedule.sh.

rules.title: GTFS schedule expiring soon
rules.summary: The active TTC GTFS schedule ends in under 7 days.
rules.description: The hourly refresh imports TTC's next package as soon as it is published, and TTC often publishes right at expiry. Check /api/health/schedule: refreshStatus success with refreshRecordsProcessed 0 and a recent refreshCompletedAt means TTC has not published yet; failed or an old refreshCompletedAt means the refresh job needs attention.
